defs.def: a long narrow piece of leather, cloth, etc. that you wear around the waist 腰带；皮带

ex.s: These pieces can be folded into a neat little pack and fastened on your belt.
ex.t: 这些部件可以折叠成一个小巧整齐的包，扣在你的腰带上。

ex.s: The ancient sea routes travelled by Zheng He are being revisited with the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road, which is part of the Belt and Road Initiative.
ex.t: 作为"一带一路"倡议的一部分，21世纪海上丝绸之路正在重新追溯郑和走过的古老航线。

ex.s: China’s global outlook, with projects such as the Belt and Road Initiative, has helped us make connections across the world.
ex.t: 中国的全球视野，以"一带一路"倡议等项目为代表，帮助我们在世界各地建立了联系。

ex.s: This century is bringing the Silk Road to life once more through the Belt and Road Initiative.
ex.t: 本世纪，通过"一带一路"倡议，丝绸之路再次焕发生机。

ex.s: What’s more, the Belt and Road Initiative will mean a new dawn for trade and investment between countries, leading into a new era of prosperity.
ex.t: 更重要的是，"一带一路"倡议将意味着国家间贸易和投资的新曙光，引领进入一个繁荣的新时代。

defs.def: a continuous band of material that moves round and is used to carry things along or to drive machinery 传送带；传动带

ex.s: Now, Cao has started the second part of his dream to walk along the Belt and Road route.
ex.t: 现在，曹已经开始了他梦想的第二部分——沿着一带一路路线行走。

defs.def: an area with particular characteristics or where a particular group of people live 地带；地区

ex.s: Background information • The Belt and Road Initiative comprises the Silk Road Economic Belt and the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road, and is designed to connect Asia with the rest of the world.
ex.t: 背景信息 "一带一路"倡议包括丝绸之路经济带和21世纪海上丝绸之路，旨在将亚洲与世界其他地区连接起来。

defs.def: an act of hitting sth/sb hard 狠打；猛击
to hit sb/sth hard 猛击；狠打
to move very fast 飞奔；飞驰
to fasten a belt around sth 绕着系上带子
to fasten your seat belt (= a belt worn by a passenger in a vehicle) 系上安全带

chunks.cn: 在…上 你的 腰带
